object.subject: Side view of a pale matte wall with one six-sided hexagon-shaped opening through which soft cool daylight falls across a pale floor in a wide diagonal, everything else cool and soft.
object.accent: a small hexagon of amber glass standing on the sill of the opening

prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Side view of a pale matte wall with one six-sided hexagon-shaped opening through which soft cool daylight falls across a pale floor in a wide diagonal, everything else cool and soft. Subject centred with a quiet margin around it. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: a small hexagon of amber glass standing on the sill of the opening. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
